name: quqii AI-Translator
author: quqii

sections.description:
quqii AI-Translator is the modern way to go global. While traditional plugins often bloat your database, quqii AI-Translator uses high-end AI to provide a seamless translation layer over your website.

Key Features

  • Instant AI Translation: Go live in any language within minutes.
  • 24 languages: From German, English and Spanish to Arabic (right to left), Hindi, Korean, Turkish and the Nordic and Eastern European languages.
  • Non-Destructive: No changes to your WordPress posts or pages. Everything stays clean.
  • Files per language: Need a different image, video or PDF for a language, for example a banner with text in it? Choose a matching file for each language right in the media library, or hide it in that language.
  • Edit in WordPress: Want to refine a word? Correct AI-generated texts right in the plugin: pages, common texts such as footer and menus, navigation, URL slugs and a glossary for names. Changes are live immediately.
  • SEO Friendly: Automatically generates hreflang & meta tags to help you rank globally.
  • Easy Setup: Install, activate, and translate.

Good to know

  • Edit texts here or in the portal. Under Pages, click the pencil next to a translated page to edit its texts. Changes made in the plugin are live immediately. Changes made in the portal need “Sync now” in the plugin, or the sync icon in the Pages and Posts list.
  • Common texts are translated once. Texts that appear on many pages, such as footer, buttons and menus, are translated only once and edited under Common (in the plugin or in the portal). They no longer appear in every page editor.
  • Empty fields hide the text. If you empty a text in the portal, it is hidden on the translated page, including the space around it. Add the CSS class quqii-keep-space to an element to keep its space.
  • Files per language. Images, videos, PDFs and other files can be replaced or hidden per language. Open the file in the media library and use the field “Version for EN”.
  • No chains. A file that is used as a replacement cannot have replacements of its own.
  • Clear cache. All pages are marked as outdated and must be translated again. Only new text uses words from your plan; texts translated elsewhere on your site and your manual corrections are kept. Existing translations stay online until then.
  • URL structure and navigation. Sync again after you add post types or change menus.
  • YouTube and Vimeo videos. Embedded videos are not media library files. Your theme has to handle them per language.

External Services

This plugin connects to the quqii Translator platform (https://translator.quqii.net) to provide AI-powered translation services.

What data is sent:
* The HTML content of pages you choose to translate (pushed from the admin dashboard, never from visitor page loads).
* Your site URL, to scope translations to your specific WordPress installation.
* Navigation menu labels and post-type rewrite slugs, for structural translation.

When data is sent:
* Only when you actively trigger a translation from the WordPress admin (Quqii → Pages or the setup wizard).
* When the platform saves a translation, it calls a REST endpoint on your site to clear the local cache — no page content is involved in that callback.

No visitor data is ever transmitted. Translations are stored locally in your WordPress database and served directly to visitors without any further API calls.

  • quqii Translator Platform: https://translator.quqii.net
  • Privacy Policy: https://translator.quqii.net/privacy
  • Imprint: https://translator.quqii.net/imprint
sections.installation:
1. Upload the quqii-translator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the quqii AI-Translator menu to connect your account.
sections.faq:
What is easy language?

A version of a page in short, simple sentences for people with learning or reading difficulties. The AI writes a draft that you must read and correct before you switch it on. It is not a certified text: real “Leichte Sprache” is checked by people from the target group.

Can visitors be sent to their own language automatically?

Yes, as an option. Under Settings, enable “Open the home page in the visitor’s language”. On a visitor’s first visit, the home page then opens in their browser language if you offer it. The choice is remembered for one year in the cookie quqii_lang. Only the home page is redirected, and search engines and link-preview bots are never redirected. Visitors can switch language at any time with the language switcher.

Does it slow down my site?

No! quqii AI-Translator uses a lightweight delivery method (local cache) that ensures your site remains fast for international visitors.

Can I edit the translations?

Yes! You have full control: edit any translation in the plugin (Pages → pencil), or in the quqii portal. Changes made in the plugin are live immediately; changes made in the portal appear after “Sync now”.

Can I show a different image, video or PDF for each language?

Yes. Open the file in your media library and find the field “Version for EN” (one field per target language). Choose “Other file” to select a replacement of the same kind, or “Hide” to show nothing in that language. On the translated pages the replacement is used instead of the original (for images in all sizes), or the file and the space around it are removed. This is useful for images that contain text, such as banners or infographics. Without a setting, the original file is used. Videos embedded from YouTube or Vimeo are not media library files and are not affected.
sections.changelog:
2.2.1

  • Changed: edited text blocks keep their translation. If you edit a text block after it was translated, visitors keep seeing the previous translation until you translate the page again. Only the “outdated” icon in the Pages list tells you that the page needs a new translation. The edited block is found again by its place on the page, between the blocks that did not change. New blocks stay in the original language until translated, deleted blocks disappear with their translation. Before, an edited block fell back to the original language.
  • Fix: mixed words in translated pages. Short stored words such as “und” were replaced inside already translated words (“grounded” became “groanded”) and inside changed blocks. Texts are now replaced in one pass, short entries only replace a complete text, and words are matched at word edges.

2.2.0

  • New: Easy language (Leichte Sprache / Easy to Read). Switch it on under Overview → Target languages → “+ Add”, for example “Deutsch (de) Leichte Sprache” or “English (en) Easy to Read”. It then appears as a tab in the Pages list next to your languages and works like a language: the same status icons and the same “Translate” button. The AI writes a draft in short, simple sentences. You read and correct it in an editor with one text field, and a switch “On website” shows it on your site. The first version of a page is written in the language of your website, other languages are made from it. Every created text counts toward your word limit, editing is free. Optional details about your website (audience, contact page) are in Settings. In the Pages and Posts lists, each easy language gets a column with the language code and an open book.
  • New: A switch in the language switcher. Where a page has a version, a link with the words “Leichte Sprache” (German) or “Easy to Read” (English) appears next to the languages, in the floating selector and in menus. The version opens as a plain, large, high-contrast page with a “Back to the normal page” button and a read-aloud button.
  • The easy language pages are not indexed by search engines (noindex) and are not part of the sitemap.
  • Requires the current quqii portal, which is updated automatically on the server side.

2.1.1

  • Improved: A calmer warning about the API token. The warning now appears only on the quqii screens, and the menu entry gets a small red mark. It says what is wrong (token not accepted, clock of the server, saved token cannot be decrypted after a move, subscription not active) and when it was noticed.
  • Improved: One failed check does not flag the token. A refused request is checked a second time first. Every successful answer from the portal clears the warning by itself.
  • Fixed: Translations stay online. Until now a token marked as invalid switched the translation features off on the website. Translated pages are now still served from the local cache, and the plugin asks the portal again only every few minutes.
  • Fixed: The token status in the Overview could show an old state.

2.1.0

  • New: 13 more languages. Swedish, Norwegian (Bokmål), Danish, Finnish, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Greek, Ukrainian, Turkish, Korean, Hindi and Arabic. The plugin now offers 24 languages.
  • New: Right-to-left support. Translated Arabic pages get dir="rtl", and your theme can load its RTL stylesheet and rtl body class. A new field under Settings → Language switcher lets you add CSS that is used on right-to-left pages only. Check the layout of Arabic pages, as it depends on your theme.
  • Improved: On right-to-left pages the floating language selector moves to the left corner.
  • Fixed: The selected language in a menu language switcher had no spacing next to the separators.
  • Requires the current quqii portal, which is updated automatically on the server side.

2.0.1

  • New: Open the home page in the visitor’s language. An optional setting under Settings → Language switcher. On a visitor’s first visit, the home page opens in their browser language if you offer it. The choice is remembered for one year in the cookie quqii_lang. Only the home page is redirected, and search engines and link-preview bots never are. The setting is off by default.
  • Improved: New icons for the “Good to know” cards in the Overview.
  • Improved: Code quality. Fixes for the findings of the WordPress plugin check (a translators comment, explicit nonce checks in the editor and documented database queries).

2.0.0

  • New: Edit translations inside WordPress. The plugin now has its own menu: Overview, Pages, Common, Navigation, Structure, Glossary and Settings. Click the pencil next to a translated page to edit its texts. Changes made in the plugin are live immediately, no sync needed.
  • New: Common translations. Texts that appear on many pages, such as footer, buttons and menus, are translated once and edited once under Common. They no longer clutter every page editor.
  • New: Glossary. Keep names such as a customer’s company unchanged, or always translate a term the same way, also inside longer sentences. One click on “Keep unchanged” in Common adds a text to the glossary.
  • New: Navigation and Structure (menu labels and translated URL prefixes) can be edited in the plugin, one language at a time.
  • New: Redesigned Pages list. One tab per language, collapsible folders for content types, status icons, word counts and last update, plus quick Edit, Translate and Exclude buttons.
  • New: Portal look. All plugin screens follow the design of the quqii portal. The fonts are bundled with the plugin, nothing is loaded from external servers.
  • New: Settings page. The language switcher, the local cache, the URL structure and the navigation sync now live under Settings.
  • Improved: Translating costs fewer words. Texts that already exist on another page of your site are reused instead of being translated again, and your manual corrections survive a re-translation.
  • Improved: Clear cache now explains exactly what it does before you confirm.
  • Renamed to quqii AI-Translator. The plugin folder, settings and links stay the same, nothing needs to be reconfigured.
  • Requires the current quqii portal, which is updated automatically on the server side.

1.0.5

  • New: Files per language. In the media library, choose for every language whether a file (image, video, audio, PDF, document) stays as it is, is replaced by another file of the same kind, or is hidden. Hidden files disappear together with their empty wrapper (figure, list item, file block). Add the class quqii-keep-space to keep the space. A file that is used as a replacement cannot have replacements of its own.
  • New: Translation status in your lists. The Pages and Posts lists (and other post types) show one icon per language: translated, outdated or changed, not translated yet, translating, word limit reached, or error. Click an icon to translate or to sync portal corrections.
  • New: “Good to know” card in the dashboard explains the less obvious parts of the plugin.
  • Improved: The corrections check always asks the platform, and shows “status unavailable” instead of “synced” if it cannot reach it.
  • Fixed: “Last synced” showed a time that was an hour off.
  • Improved: The dashboard buttons share one style.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.0.4

  • Tip: Images per language. If an image contains text or simply needs to look different in another language, open it in the media library and pick a matching image in the “Image for EN” (or FR, ES, …) field. The replacement is used on that language’s pages, in all sizes. Images without a replacement stay as they are.
  • New: Redesigned dashboard. Your plan, word usage and manual corrections are shown at a glance, with a clear note that translations are edited in the quqii Translator portal.
  • New: “URL structure” and “Navigation” now show whether they are already synced (green check) or still to do.
  • New: Clear cache explains what it does before you confirm: pages are marked as outdated and need to be translated again, which uses words from your plan.
  • New: Emptying a text in the portal now hides it on the translated page, including the empty line or spacing left behind. Add the CSS class quqii-keep-space to an element to keep its spacing.
  • New: The quqii AI-Translator logo in the plugin header.
  • Improved: The language switcher settings are split into two clear cards.
  • Fixed: The “Sync now” button stayed highlighted after syncing because of a time zone mismatch.
  • Fixed: The word-limit notice no longer appears on every admin page. It is shown only in the plugin’s usage card.

1.0.3

  • New: Language-specific images. In the media library, choose an alternative image for each target language; it replaces the original on the translated pages, including all image sizes.
  • Fixed: A translated page could show the wrong content when two different content types had the same URL name.
  • Fixed: Adding a language no longer switches off the language switcher settings.

1.0.2

  • Improved: The language switcher now appears reliably in menus across a wider range of themes.
  • Fixed: Removed a stray bullet point that could appear before the language flags in some themes.
  • New: Pages you edited manually in the quqii Translator portal are now marked with an “Edited” badge in the dashboard.
  • Improved: The “Sync now” button is highlighted whenever manual corrections are waiting to be synced.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of quqii Translator.
